description: Look up the risk profile and geolocation of an IPv4 or IPv6 address. Returns a 0-100 risk score measuring the freshness and strength of verifiable risk evidence (proxy, VPN, dial-up pool, cloud phone, datacenter), the evidence state, network (ASN, usage type) and geographic attribution. The score is NOT a probability that the address is an attacker. Free tier: 500 lookups per day per client IP and 60 per minute; higher limits with an API key sent as the X-API-Key header (https://ip99.com/en/pricing).

ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up, e.g. 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888.

name: ip_risk_lookup
title: IP risk & geolocation lookup
